items.title: Why Agentic AI Could Redefine the Future of Design and Verification
items.excerpt: Siemens EDA describes a shift from engineers operating individual tools toward orchestrating integrated, exploratory agentic design and verification workflows, framing an emerging Design & Verification Scientist role.

items.title: Towards factory deployment: How AEON is trained to perform
items.excerpt: Hexagon Robotics and Schaeffler describe a Train–Validate–Deploy loop for the AEON humanoid in a dedicated industrial gym, supporting a planned rollout of at least 1,000 robots across Schaeffler manufacturing operations.

items.title: Agentic AI Within the Simulation Engineering Space
